content.text: The URL in confirmNewEmail uses '/confirm-email'; it should be '/confirm-new-email'.

candidates.explanation: The confirm-new-email mail builds its link with the path '/confirm-email', the same path userSignUp uses. The frontend handles that page by calling the sign-up endpoint auth/email/confirm, so the email-change hash (a JWT containing newEmail) goes to confirmEmail instead of confirmNewEmail (auth/email/confirm/new). The email change is therefore never applied. The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
